title: A BasedOn chain of paragraph styles
concept: Body inherits from the [No paragraph style] root and Body Indented from Body, each naming its parent in a typed BasedOn Properties child. The applied style resolves by walking the chain.

annotations.note: The root [No paragraph style] carries the document's base size and fill, and its font as a typed AppliedFont inside Properties (InDesign ignores an AppliedFont attribute). It is the bottom of every chain.

Body names its parent in a typed BasedOn child of Properties, the spelling InDesign writes and reads: type="object" with the parent's Self. It sets PointSize and SpaceAfter and inherits the font and FillColor from the root.
Body Indented is based on Body: it sets only FirstLineIndent and inherits everything else through Body to the root.
